iOS Simulator.what: iOS simulators booted from Xcode. Each one runs dozens of iPhone daemons.
iOS Simulator.advice: Shut it down when you're done with the app. They never idle on their own.

com.apple.CoreSimulator.CoreSimulatorSer.title: Simulator service
com.apple.CoreSimulator.CoreSimulatorSer.what: Xcode's background service that creates, boots and manages iOS simulators; simctl and Xcode talk to it.
com.apple.CoreSimulator.CoreSimulatorSer.advice: Busy while simulators boot or install apps. Stop simulators in the Controls tab; it idles once none run.

Xcode.what: Xcode, Apple's IDE: indexing, building, previews.
Xcode.advice: Busy after opening a project or switching branches. Quit it when not coding iOS.

swift-frontend.title: Swift compiler
swift-frontend.what: The Swift compiler, running a build.
swift-frontend.advice: Ends when the build ends. Long runs mean a big rebuild.

compile.title: Go compiler
compile.what: The Go compiler, running a build or test.

clang.title: Clang compiler
clang.what: The C/C++/Objective-C compiler, running a build.

mcp.title: MCP server
mcp.what: A Model Context Protocol server, a plug-in an AI app (Claude, Cursor, VS Code) starts with npx to give its assistant extra tools. This one: @spectrumui/mcp.
mcp.advice: It lives as long as the AI app that started it. Quit or restart that app if it piles up; remove unused servers from its MCP settings.

StrainHelper.title: Strain helper
StrainHelper.what: Strain's own admin helper: runs the lock tiles, holds AirDrop off in Low ping and reads Login Items, only for Strain.
StrainHelper.advice: Nothing to do. It starts when Strain needs it and quits itself after 30 s idle. Turn it off in Controls if you don't want it.

node.title: Node.js
node.what: A Node.js process: a dev server, build tool or CLI.
node.advice: Check which project started it before quitting.

bun.title: Bun
bun.what: A Bun process: a dev server, build or script.
bun.advice: Check which project started it before quitting.

claude.title: Claude Code
claude.what: A Claude Code session running in a terminal or the desktop app.
claude.advice: Each session costs memory. Close the ones you're done with.

Claude.what: The Claude desktop app and its helper processes.
Claude.advice: Long sessions grow its memory. Restart the app if it passes 2 GB.

Brave Browser.what: Brave and all its tabs and helpers.
Brave Browser.advice: Close heavy tabs, or check Brave's own Task Manager (Shift+Esc).

Google Chrome.what: Chrome and all its tabs and helpers.
Google Chrome.advice: Close heavy tabs, or check Chrome's own Task Manager (Shift+Esc).

Spotify.what: Spotify. Its cache and web views grow memory over long sessions.
Spotify.advice: Restart it if it holds over 1 GB.

Safari.what: Safari and its web content processes.

OrbStack.what: OrbStack, the Docker and Linux VM engine. Holds all running containers' memory.
OrbStack.advice: Stop stacks you aren't using, or quit OrbStack.

Docker.what: Docker Desktop and its Linux VM.
Docker.advice: Stop containers you aren't using, or quit Docker.

Antigravity.what: The Antigravity editor and its language servers.
Antigravity.advice: Quit it when not in use.

llama-server.title: Local LLM (llama.cpp)
llama-server.what: A local LLM server (llama.cpp), such as a local chat or embedding model. Holds the whole model in memory.
llama-server.advice: Quit it when you aren't using the model. Running two at once can exhaust RAM.

whisper-server.title: Whisper speech-to-text
whisper-server.what: A local speech-to-text server (whisper.cpp), such as a local transcriber.
whisper-server.advice: Quit it when you aren't transcribing.

diskimages-helper.title: Disk images
diskimages-helper.what: macOS mounting or reading a disk image (.dmg) or simulator volume.
diskimages-helper.advice: Busy while a disk image is open or being verified. Eject images you're done with.

WindowServer.title: Window Server
WindowServer.what: macOS's screen compositor. Draws every window.
WindowServer.advice: High when many windows, displays or animations are active. Can't be quit.

kernel_task.title: Kernel
kernel_task.what: The macOS kernel. Also throttles the CPU when the Mac is hot.
kernel_task.advice: High usage often means heat. Can't be quit.

mediaanalysisd.title: Photos analysis
mediaanalysisd.what: Photos scanning faces, objects and scenes in your library.
mediaanalysisd.advice: Finishes on its own. Restart if it runs for days.

photoanalysisd.title: Photos memories
photoanalysisd.what: Photos building memories and people albums.

suggestd.title: Siri Suggestions
suggestd.what: Siri Suggestions indexing mail, messages and apps.
suggestd.advice: Finishes on its own. Turn off Siri Suggestions to stop it.

mobileassetd.title: System downloads
mobileassetd.what: macOS downloading system assets: fonts, voices, AI models.
mobileassetd.advice: Common after an update. Finishes on its own.

softwareupdated.title: Software Update
softwareupdated.what: macOS checking for or preparing a system update.

PerfPowerServicesSignpostReader.title: Power logging
PerfPowerServicesSignpostReader.advice: Finishes on its own. Restart if it stays high for hours.

logd.title: System log
logd.what: macOS's system log. Busy when something is logging heavily.
logd.advice: Look for another process that is misbehaving. Can't be quit.

duetexpertd.title: Usage learning
duetexpertd.what: macOS learning your app usage patterns.

mds.title: Spotlight
mds.advice: Busy after lots of file changes. Exclude build folders in Spotlight settings.

mds_stores.title: Spotlight index
mds_stores.advice: Busy after lots of file changes. Exclude build folders in Spotlight settings.

mdworker_shared.title: Spotlight indexer
mdworker_shared.what: Spotlight reading files to index them.
mdworker_shared.advice: Exclude node_modules and build folders in Spotlight settings.

fseventsd.title: File change tracker
fseventsd.what: macOS tracking file changes for Spotlight, Time Machine and apps.
fseventsd.advice: High during big file operations like installs or builds.

cloudd.title: iCloud sync
cloudd.advice: Busy after big changes in iCloud Drive or Photos.

bird.title: iCloud Drive
bird.advice: Busy after big changes in iCloud Drive.

BackgroundShortcutRunner.title: Shortcuts automation
BackgroundShortcutRunner.what: Shortcuts running an automation in the background.
BackgroundShortcutRunner.advice: Check Shortcuts for an automation that runs too often.

triald.title: Apple feature trials
triald.what: Apple's on-device experiment and feature config service.

syspolicyd.title: Gatekeeper
syspolicyd.what: Gatekeeper checking apps and binaries you run.
syspolicyd.advice: High after many new binaries, like a build. Can't be quit.

trustd.title: Certificate checks
trustd.what: macOS checking certificates and code signatures.

opendirectoryd.title: Directory services
opendirectoryd.advice: Can't be quit. Steady high use may mean a misbehaving app.

MTLAssetUpgraderD.title: GPU shader upgrade
MTLAssetUpgraderD.what: macOS recompiling GPU shaders, usually after an update.

coreaudiod.title: Core Audio
coreaudiod.what: macOS's audio engine. Busy while anything plays or records sound.
coreaudiod.advice: High CPU usually means an app is playing or recording. Can't be quit.

com.macpaw.CleanMyMac-setapp.HealthMonit.title: CleanMyMac monitor
com.macpaw.CleanMyMac-setapp.HealthMonit.advice: Turn off its menu bar monitor in CleanMyMac settings if you don't use it.

WhatsApp.what: WhatsApp and its notification service extension.
WhatsApp.advice: Quit it if you don't need messages on the Mac. Large chats with media grow its memory.

MTLCompilerService.title: GPU shader compiler
MTLCompilerService.what: macOS compiling Metal GPU shaders for an app or game.
MTLCompilerService.advice: Spikes when an app starts or updates. Finishes on its own. Can't be quit.

MenuBarAgent.title: Menu bar
MenuBarAgent.what: macOS drawing the menu bar and its extras.
MenuBarAgent.advice: High with many menu bar apps or a live-updating item. Can't be quit.

BiomeAgent.title: Biome (usage data)
BiomeAgent.what: macOS recording app and device usage for Siri, Screen Time and suggestions.
BiomeAgent.advice: Finishes on its own. Can't be quit.

CursorUIViewService.title: Text cursor UI
CursorUIViewService.what: macOS drawing the text cursor and its input-mode indicator.
CursorUIViewService.advice: Brief spikes while typing are normal. Can't be quit.

ContextStoreAgent.title: Context store
ContextStoreAgent.what: macOS tracking context (location, activity, focus) for system features.
ContextStoreAgent.advice: Finishes on its own. Can't be quit.

WindowManager.title: Stage Manager
WindowManager.what: macOS window management: Stage Manager, desktop widgets and tiling.
WindowManager.advice: Busy with many windows or widgets. Turn off Stage Manager or widgets if it stays high.

com.macpaw.CleanMyMac-setapp.Agent.title: CleanMyMac admin helper
com.macpaw.CleanMyMac-setapp.Agent.what: CleanMyMac's root helper: lets it delete system files and run maintenance without asking each time.
com.macpaw.CleanMyMac-setapp.Agent.advice: Remove CleanMyMac if you don't use it; this goes with it.

CleanMyMac Health Monitor.what: CleanMyMac's always-on monitor (CPU, memory, disk alerts).
CleanMyMac Health Monitor.advice: Strain covers this. Turn it off to save ~170 MB.

dev.orbstack.OrbStack.privhelper.title: OrbStack admin helper
dev.orbstack.OrbStack.privhelper.what: OrbStack's root helper for networking and Docker sockets.

AWDLControl.what: Turns off AWDL (the AirDrop/AirPlay radio) to cut Wi-Fi lag spikes.
AWDLControl.advice: Keep if you notice Wi-Fi latency; AirDrop won't work while it's on.

AWDLControlHelper.title: AWDLControl admin helper
AWDLControlHelper.what: Root helper that lets AWDLControl switch the AirDrop radio.

GoogleUpdater.title: Google Updater
GoogleUpdater.what: Keeps Chrome and other Google apps updated.
GoogleUpdater.advice: Needed only if you keep Chrome.

Setapp.advice: Needed only while you use Setapp apps.

SetappLauncher.advice: Off if you open Setapp yourself.

SetappUpdater.advice: Needed only while you use Setapp apps.

SetappAssistant.what: Setapp's helper for app suggestions and installs.

StartUpHelper.title: Spotify at login
StartUpHelper.what: Opens Spotify when you log in.
StartUpHelper.advice: Turn off and open Spotify yourself.

TailscaleLoginItemHelper.title: Tailscale at login
TailscaleLoginItemHelper.what: Starts Tailscale at login so your tailnet stays connected.
TailscaleLoginItemHelper.advice: Keep: your infra access depends on it.

MonitorControlHelper.title: MonitorControl at login
MonitorControlHelper.advice: Off is fine if you don't use an external display.

Bitwarden.what: Bitwarden password manager, opens at login.
Bitwarden.advice: Keep if you use it daily.

CleanShot X.what: Screenshot and recording tool, waits for its shortcuts.

Google Drive.what: Syncs Google Drive files to this Mac.
Google Drive.advice: Keep if you sync; it uses memory and disk all day.

Lungo.what: Keeps the Mac awake on demand (menu bar).
Lungo.advice: Off at login is fine; open it when needed.

Grok Bot - background tasks.advice: Turn off its background tasks if you rarely use it.

NVIDIA GeForce NOW - background tasks.advice: Turn off its background tasks unless you game often.

Cursor - background tasks.what: The Cursor code editor (you have it installed).
Cursor - background tasks.advice: Its background tasks are already blocked. Uninstall it if you don't use it.

cloudflared.title: Cloudflare tunnel
cloudflared.what: A Cloudflare Tunnel: makes a local server reachable from the internet through Cloudflare.
cloudflared.advice: Stop it when you don't need the public URL.

pmtiles.title: PMTiles tool
pmtiles.what: Protomaps' map-tile tool (extracting or serving .pmtiles map data), started from a Claude session's scratchpad.
pmtiles.advice: Usually a one-off job. Stop it if no session still needs it.

Strain.what: This app: samples processes, ports and memory every 10 s.
Strain.advice: Should stay under 1% CPU and ~40 MB. If it's higher, report it.

top.title: top (terminal)
top.what: The `top` process monitor running in a terminal.
top.advice: Quit it with q when you're done; it samples every process continuously.

loginwindow.title: Login window
loginwindow.what: macOS's session manager: your login, lock screen and the apps of your session.
loginwindow.advice: Can't be quit; quitting it logs you out. Brief spikes at unlock or wake are normal.

tmux.what: tmux, the terminal multiplexer: keeps shell sessions alive after a terminal closes.
tmux.advice: Light by itself; check what runs inside its panes. Close sessions you no longer use (tmux ls, tmux kill-session).

UniversalControl.title: Universal Control
UniversalControl.what: Shares this Mac's keyboard and mouse with a nearby iPad or Mac, and runs AirPlay to Mac.
UniversalControl.advice: Can't be quit. Turn it off in System Settings > Displays > Advanced if you never use it.

bluetoothd.title: Bluetooth
bluetoothd.what: The Bluetooth daemon: keyboards, mice, AirPods, Continuity.
bluetoothd.advice: Can't be quit. Sustained CPU usually means a flaky device; unpair and re-pair it.

Ghostty.advice: Memory grows with scrollback and open tabs. Close idle windows, or restart it if it creeps up.

ControlCenter.title: Control Center
ControlCenter.what: macOS's Control Center and the menu bar's status icons.
ControlCenter.advice: Can't be quit; macOS restarts it. Use Clean > Restart menu bar if icons freeze.

clocksyncd.title: Clock sync
clocksyncd.what: Keeps the system clock in sync with Apple's time servers.
clocksyncd.advice: Can't be quit. Normally idle; ends its work on its own.

com.apple.WebKit.WebContent.title: Web page (WebKit)
com.apple.WebKit.WebContent.what: One web page or web view rendered by Safari, Mail or any app using WebKit.
com.apple.WebKit.WebContent.advice: Close the heavy tab or window in that app. Activity Monitor shows which page it is.

com.apple.DriverKit-AppleBCMWLAN.title: Wi-Fi driver
com.apple.DriverKit-AppleBCMWLAN.what: The Wi-Fi chip's driver, running in user space.
com.apple.DriverKit-AppleBCMWLAN.advice: Can't be quit. High CPU follows heavy network traffic or a weak signal; toggling Wi-Fi resets it.

sleep.what: The sleep command: a script waiting for a timer.
sleep.advice: Uses no CPU. It belongs to whatever script started it.

Tailscale.what: Tailscale, the mesh VPN app linking your devices.
Tailscale.advice: Light when idle. Busy while syncing the network map or moving traffic; quit it from its menu if you don't need the tailnet.

launchd.what: The first process macOS starts; it launches and supervises every other one.
launchd.advice: Can't be quit. High CPU means something keeps crashing and being relaunched; look for it.

powerd.title: Power manager
powerd.what: Manages sleep, wake, battery and power assertions.
powerd.advice: Can't be quit. To see what blocks sleep: pmset -g assertions.

corebrightnessd.title: Display brightness
corebrightnessd.what: Auto-brightness, True Tone and Night Shift.

notifyd.title: Notification center (system)
notifyd.what: macOS's low-level messaging between processes, not the banner notifications.
notifyd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy only when another process floods it.

SetStoreUpdateService.title: Set Store updater
SetStoreUpdateService.what: A macOS service that refreshes on-device data sets for system features.
SetStoreUpdateService.advice: Runs briefly and ends on its own.

brief.finance.what: brief.finance's widgets (the BriefWidgets extension), updating Notification Center and desktop widgets.
brief.finance.advice: macOS runs it on a schedule and ends it. Remove the widget if it stays busy.

Dock.what: The Dock, Launchpad, Mission Control and Spaces.
Dock.advice: Can't be quit for good; macOS restarts it. Use Clean > Restart Dock if it hangs.

linkd.title: App Intents indexer
linkd.what: Indexes apps' Shortcuts and App Intents for Siri and Spotlight.
linkd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy after installing or updating apps, then idles.

contactsd.title: Contacts
contactsd.what: Syncs and indexes your contacts for every app.
contactsd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy after a big iCloud contacts sync, then idles.

com.apple.geod.title: Location data (Maps)
com.apple.geod.what: Downloads and caches map tiles and place data for Maps, Weather and Find My.
com.apple.geod.advice: Can't be quit. Ends its work on its own.

com.apple.WebKit.Networking.title: Web networking (WebKit)
com.apple.WebKit.Networking.what: Does the network loading for Safari, Mail and every app that shows web content.
com.apple.WebKit.Networking.advice: Can't be quit by itself; it ends with the apps using it. Busy during big downloads or many open tabs.

Siri AI.what: Apple's Siri AI app: the assistant and its on-device models.
Siri AI.advice: Busy while answering or after an update while models load. Quit it if you don't use it; turn Siri off in System Settings to stop it starting.

com.apple.quicklook.ThumbnailsAgent.title: Thumbnail maker (Quick Look)
com.apple.quicklook.ThumbnailsAgent.what: Makes file thumbnails for Finder, open dialogs and Spotlight.
com.apple.quicklook.ThumbnailsAgent.advice: Ends on its own. Busy after opening a folder full of images or videos; use Clean > Reset Quick Look if it stays busy.

PerfPowerServices.title: Power and performance logger
PerfPowerServices.what: Records battery, energy and performance stats for Battery settings and diagnostics.
PerfPowerServices.advice: Can't be quit. Busy in short bursts while it writes its logs, then idles.

sh.title: Shell script
sh.what: A /bin/sh shell running a script or command for another app or tool.
sh.advice: Ends when its script ends. Expand the row and check the path's parent (Activity Monitor > Sample) to see who started it.

WallpaperImageExtension.title: Wallpaper
WallpaperImageExtension.what: Draws the desktop wallpaper, including dynamic and photo-rotation wallpapers.
WallpaperImageExtension.advice: Can't be quit; macOS restarts it. A still image instead of a dynamic or shuffling wallpaper keeps it idle.

spotlightknowledged.updater.title: Spotlight knowledge updater
spotlightknowledged.updater.what: Refreshes the facts and suggestions Spotlight and Siri show (Siri Suggestions, Knowledge).
spotlightknowledged.updater.advice: Can't be quit. Runs briefly in the background and ends on its own.

locationd.title: Location Services
locationd.what: Works out this Mac's location for Maps, Weather, Find My, time zone and any app you allowed.
locationd.advice: Can't be quit. If it stays busy, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Location Services and turn off apps that don't need it.

Finder.what: Finder, the file browser and the desktop.
Finder.advice: Busy while copying, indexing a big folder or drawing thumbnails. Use Clean > Restart Finder if it hangs.

gh.title: GitHub CLI
gh.what: GitHub's command-line tool (gh), run by you, a script or an agent.
gh.advice: Ends when its command ends. A long-running one is usually `gh run watch` or a stuck auth or API call; stop it in its terminal.

lsd.title: Launch Services
lsd.what: Keeps the database of installed apps and which app opens which file type.
lsd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy after installing apps; Clean > Fix "Open With" rebuilds its database if it misbehaves.

eligibilityd.title: Feature eligibility
eligibilityd.what: Checks which macOS features (such as Apple Intelligence) this Mac and region qualify for.
eligibilityd.advice: Can't be quit. Runs briefly after updates or region changes, then idles.

tccd.title: Privacy permissions
tccd.what: Answers every privacy check: camera, microphone, files, screen recording, automation.
tccd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy when an app keeps asking for a permission; find that app and decide in Privacy & Security.

XprotectService.title: XProtect (malware scan)
XprotectService.what: Apple's built-in antivirus, scanning apps and downloads.
XprotectService.advice: Can't be quit, and you shouldn't want to. Busy after downloads or installs, then idles.

chronod.title: Widgets
chronod.what: Runs and refreshes desktop and Notification Center widgets.
chronod.advice: Can't be quit. If it stays busy, remove widgets you don't look at.

cfprefsd.title: Preferences
cfprefsd.what: Reads and writes every app's settings (preference files).
cfprefsd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy when an app writes its settings in a loop; find the app with the high CPU next to it.

sharingd.title: Sharing (AirDrop, Handoff)
sharingd.what: Runs AirDrop, Handoff, Universal Clipboard and nearby-device discovery.
sharingd.advice: Can't be quit. Set AirDrop to Contacts Only or Off, and turn off Handoff if you don't use them.

XProtectBridgeService.title: XProtect bridge
XProtectBridgeService.what: Connects Apple's XProtect malware scanner to the rest of macOS.
XProtectBridgeService.advice: Can't be quit. Ends its work on its own.

SecurityAgent.title: Password prompt
SecurityAgent.what: Shows macOS's admin password and Touch ID sheets.
SecurityAgent.advice: Ends once you answer the prompt. If it lingers, a sheet is waiting behind a window.

runningboardd.title: App lifecycle manager
runningboardd.what: Decides which apps and extensions may run, sleep or be suspended, and how much memory they get.
runningboardd.advice: Can't be quit. Busy when apps launch and quit a lot; it settles on its own.

proactived.title: Siri Suggestions
proactived.what: Predicts which apps, contacts and actions to suggest in Spotlight, Siri and the share sheet.
proactived.advice: Can't be quit. Turn off suggestions in System Settings > Siri & Spotlight if it stays busy.

IntelligencePlatformComputeService.title: Apple Intelligence indexing
IntelligencePlatformComputeService.what: Builds Apple Intelligence's on-device knowledge of your mail, messages, photos and files.
IntelligencePlatformComputeService.advice: Can't be quit. Heavy for hours after setup or a big update, then mostly idles. Leave the Mac on power to let it finish.

SystemUIServer.title: Menu bar (system)
SystemUIServer.what: Draws the right side of the menu bar: clock, input menu and third-party menu bar extras.
SystemUIServer.advice: Can't be quit; macOS restarts it. Use Clean > Restart menu bar if icons freeze.

CleanMyMac.what: CleanMyMac (Setapp): the app, its Health Monitor and its Finder extension.
CleanMyMac.advice: Strain covers its monitoring. Quit it, and remove its Finder extension in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions if you keep it installed.

python.title: Python
python.what: A Python process: a script, notebook, dev server or AI tool.
python.advice: Check which project started it (expand the row for the path) before quitting.

perl.title: Perl
perl.what: A Perl script. macOS and tools like git, exiftool and ImageMagick helpers run Perl for short jobs.
perl.advice: Usually finishes on its own. If it runs long, check what started it in Activity Monitor before quitting.

ruby.title: Ruby
ruby.what: A Ruby process: a script, Rails server or CLI.
ruby.advice: Check which project started it before quitting.

java.title: Java
java.what: A Java process: an IDE, build tool (Gradle, Maven) or server.
java.advice: Java holds a lot of memory by design. Stop Gradle daemons with `gradle --stop`.

go.title: Go
go.what: The go command: building, testing or downloading modules.
go.advice: Ends when its command ends. A long-running one belongs to a terminal, script or agent; stop it there.

gopls.title: Go language server
gopls.what: Powers Go autocomplete and errors in your editor.
gopls.advice: Grows with big repos. Restart it from the editor, or close Go projects you're done with.

sourcekit-lsp.title: Swift language server
sourcekit-lsp.what: Powers Swift autocomplete and errors in your editor.
sourcekit-lsp.advice: Restart it from the editor if it stays busy.

deno.title: Deno
deno.what: A Deno process: a dev server, script or CLI.
deno.advice: Check which project started it before quitting.

postgres.title: PostgreSQL
postgres.what: A PostgreSQL database server, one process per connection.
postgres.advice: Stop it with the tool that started it (Docker, brew services, Postgres.app).

redis-server.title: Redis
redis-server.advice: Stop it with the tool that started it (Docker, brew services).

valkey-server.title: Valkey
valkey-server.advice: Stop it with the tool that started it (Docker, brew services).

ollama.title: Ollama
ollama.what: Runs local AI models. A loaded model holds GBs of memory.
ollama.advice: Models unload after 5 idle minutes. `ollama stop <model>` frees it now.

git.title: Git
git.what: A git command: fetch, status, gc or a hook.
git.advice: Ends when its command ends. A long-running one belongs to a terminal, script or agent; stop it there.

ssh.title: SSH
ssh.what: An SSH connection to another machine, or a tunnel.
ssh.advice: Ends when the connection closes. Close the terminal tab that holds it.

zsh.title: Zsh shell
zsh.what: A terminal shell, or a script running in one.
zsh.advice: Light by itself. Check what runs inside it.

bash.title: Bash shell
bash.what: A bash shell running a script or command.
bash.advice: Ends when its script ends. Check what started it.

rsync.title: rsync
rsync.what: Copies or syncs files, often for a backup.

ffmpeg.title: FFmpeg
ffmpeg.what: Converts or records audio and video. Heavy on CPU by nature.
ffmpeg.advice: Ends when the job ends. Run big jobs with `nice` so the Mac stays responsive.

cargo.title: Rust build (cargo)
cargo.what: Rust's build tool, compiling or testing.

rustc.title: Rust compiler
rustc.what: The Rust compiler, running a build.

make.title: make
make.what: A make build or task runner.
make.advice: Ends when its command ends. A long-running one belongs to a terminal, script or agent; stop it there.

esbuild.title: esbuild
esbuild.what: A JavaScript bundler, usually inside Vite or a dev server.
esbuild.advice: Ends with the dev server that started it.

docker.title: Docker CLI
docker.what: A docker command: build, compose or logs.
docker.advice: Ends when its command ends. A long-running one belongs to a terminal, script or agent; stop it there.

codex.title: Codex CLI
codex.what: An OpenAI Codex agent session in a terminal.
codex.advice: Each session costs memory. Close the ones you're done with.

Visual Studio Code.what: VS Code with its extensions, language servers and terminals.
Visual Studio Code.advice: Heavy extensions and big workspaces add up. Close windows you're done with.

Cursor.what: Cursor (VS Code-based AI editor) with its extensions and indexers.
Cursor.advice: Close windows you're done with; indexing big repos is heavy for a while.

Slack.advice: Grows over long sessions. Restart it if it passes 1 GB.

zoom.us.title: Zoom
zoom.us.what: Zoom meetings. Video calls are heavy on CPU.
zoom.us.advice: Quit it after the call; it keeps helpers running.

Microsoft Teams.what: Microsoft Teams and its web views.
Microsoft Teams.advice: Quit it when you're not in meetings or chats.

Discord.advice: Restart it if it passes 1 GB.

Notion.what: Notion, a web app in a desktop shell.
Notion.advice: Close pages you're done with; restart it if it grows past 1 GB.

Figma.what: Figma and its open design files.
Figma.advice: Big files take GBs. Close tabs you're done with.

Firefox.advice: Close heavy tabs, or open about:processes to see which.

Arc.what: Arc browser and all its tabs.
Arc.advice: Close heavy tabs, or archive old ones.

Obsidian.what: Obsidian notes app and its plugins.
Obsidian.advice: Heavy plugins and big vaults add memory. Disable plugins you don't use.

1Password.advice: Normally light. Keep it running for autofill.

ps.title: Process list (ps)
ps.what: Lists running processes. Strain runs it every 10 seconds to take its sample.
ps.advice: Ends in milliseconds. If you see it often, it's Strain (or another monitor) sampling.

deadcode.title: Go dead code finder
deadcode.what: The deadcode tool, scanning a Go module for functions nothing calls.
deadcode.advice: Ends when the scan ends. Big repos take a while; stop it in the terminal or agent that started it.

gpg-agent.title: GPG agent
gpg-agent.what: Holds your unlocked GPG keys so git commits and other signing don't ask for the passphrase every time.
gpg-agent.advice: Normally idle. If it spins, run gpgconf --kill gpg-agent; it restarts on the next signature.

link.title: Go linker
link.what: The Go linker, joining compiled packages into one binary during a build or test.
link.advice: Ends when the build ends. Heavy on memory for big binaries.

golangci-lint.title: Go linter
golangci-lint.what: golangci-lint, running dozens of Go linters over a repo, often from a git hook or editor.
golangci-lint.advice: Ends when the lint run ends. Heavy on big repos; its cache makes later runs faster.

api.title: Local API server
api.what: A dev API server built from your code, usually a Go app rebuilt and restarted by a hot reload tool like air.
api.advice: Runs until you stop its dev stack. Stop it in the terminal, tmux or launch config that started it.

grype.title: Grype scanner
grype.what: Grype, scanning a project or image for packages with known vulnerabilities.
grype.advice: Ends when the scan ends. The first run downloads its vulnerability database, which is slow.

osv-scanner.title: OSV scanner
osv-scanner.what: osv-scanner, checking a project's dependencies against Google's open source vulnerability database.
osv-scanner.advice: Ends when the scan ends. Stop it in the terminal or hook that started it if it hangs.
